bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot language model performance on a newly created, culturally grounded dataset (ArabCulture) using multiple-choice and sentence completion questions to test knowledge of Arab social norms, traditions, and daily life, thereby exposing Western-centric/Anglocentric biases in existing models.

Comparing model reasoning accuracy across 13 different Arab countries and 4 broader regions (Gulf, Levant, North Africa, Nile Valley) by categorizing questions as country-specific or non-country-specific, and testing with varying levels of location-based contextual grounding in the prompts.
